2121056565910499623.en_summary: (Reposted by @edzitron) Then what happened. Quoted: Days before Christmas 2023, emailed Jensen after investor pulled out. No cash for payroll, talking bankruptcy. Jensen called at 6am, later dinner with team to bridge the company. Four months later rang NASDAQ bell for IPO.
2121056565910499623.zh_summary: (轉推自 @edzitron) 然後發生了什麼。引用：2023年聖誕前幾天，投資者最後一刻撤出後電郵 Jensen。沒有現金支付薪資，正在與破產律師交談。Jensen 早上6點來電，當天晚些時候與團隊共進晚餐為公司提供橋樑融資。四個月後為 IPO 敲響納斯達克鐘。
